description: Source code for the TranslatorMetal class, a GLSL-based shader translator for Metal backend, derived from TranslatorVulkan, handling shader translation, viewport correction, and depth transformation.

classes.name: TranslatorMetal
classes.description: Shader translator class for Metal backend, extending TranslatorVulkan, handling shader translation and depth correction.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Performs shader translation, appends viewport correction for vertex shaders, and outputs the translated shader.

methods.name: transformDepthBeforeCorrection
methods.description: Modifies gl_Position.z for depth inversion if depth range is reversed.
